concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-reconciliation-use-cases-first-year-focus-platform-level-reporting]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms first-year worked methods for monthly, transaction, user, and invoice profitability/reconciliation, with blended-pricing and report-grain limits.
warnings: Monthly payout-minus-invoice comparison is an initial indication and needs liable-account adjustments plus timing alignment; report rows do not prove bank receipt.
Transaction-level profitability method applies only to blended pricing and omits nontransactional costs.
Raw user effective-rate sentence is incomplete and sample cost-recommendation currency abbreviations are malformed; avoid deriving a rate formula or current price tariff from them.
